svg.title: TOPAK C2 — Alphabets by seat: nine variants, two domains, three seat kinds
svg.desc: Each domain has its own typed alphabet and no variant name is shared; only the carrier, epoch and lease on every action, is common. Which seat kind may express which variant is bounded twice: by the grant path, which refuses an alphabet outside the kind's row, and by the policy floor at admit (ADR-0037 §4, ADR-0043 §2). The floor text cited here is DRAFT, not ratified (G9 §2.2).
svg.text: TOPAK · C2

text.tspan: The carrier is shared: every action carries epoch and lease (ADR-0022 §2; ADR-0040 §2)

svg.text: Actions under a fenced epoch are rejected by the mechanism, not by policy, ahead of the floor; the floor states no epoch fence (genesis-floor.cedar header). The lease (ADR-0031) carries the seat, its alphabet and its domain; at the reference the bearer token carries (seat, lease, epoch) into every action, and a lease the launcher issues mints none: at rung 1 the bridge is the session (mechanism/ I14; ADR-0033 A7, pending).
Corpus root: a pinned, content-addressed set; Read is scoped to it. Whether it is poisoned is an Observer
finding, not an enforcement decision.
Tool allowlist: name plus digest; each entry carries a hermeticity obligation: no network, no filesystem
outside the workspace, deterministic given its inputs.
Round bound: maximum actions per round; termination, and it bounds the state space.
Run root: a second pinned, content-addressed set; Consult is scoped to it.
Tool allowlist: name plus digest and, per entry, the effect channel it opens, declared. A Run tool is not
hermetic and is not asked to be.
Round bound R: admits per round over all three variants; per domain; a placeholder number.
One allowlisted tool with a socket collapses the envelope to vacuity (ADR-0022 Negative).
Wasm components: discharged by construction, ADR-0034 P4: instantiated per call, a workspace
directory capability only; no sockets, no wall clock, no free entropy.
Native tools: unowned. Using one is declared degeneracy D-0034-3: P4 falsified, the principals reaching
it are Mediated.
At the reference a Build profile that says P4 passes is not yet held to Wasm tools for Invoke (G9 item
P4 cannot hold for a Run tool; channel fidelity replaces it: a tool opens the channel its entry declares and
no other (ADR-0042 §6, Proposed).
Owner drafted: ADR-0034 A2 (pending, C2, C4) writes the Run profile with P4 as channel fidelity, held by
the tool host's Wasm runtime by construction; ADR-0033 A8 (pending) builds it: a Wasm-hosted Run tool
reaches only its declared target (I44).
Native Run tools: checked by nobody (G19): D-0034-6, or D-0034-5 behind an egress filter, a trust. The
bundle checks only that channel: {kind, target} is well-shaped (I33); the channel is declared twice
and not checked to agree (G9 item 84).
Until A2 and §6 are ratified, Run principals are Mediated (G9 §2.5, items 58, 80).

Only a thinker seat holds a variant that writes, runs or offers (Draft, Invoke, Submit, Actuate), and a thinker seat never votes (ADR-0037 §4). A Reader with Draft authority, the failure ADR-0022's follow-up named, cannot arise: the Reader is not a principal. A narrower lease is always allowed (ADR-0031 §4), so an observer seat without Consult needs no declaration (ADR-0043 §7).

context.erasureQuorum: false from epoch 0, since genesis issues no erasure roster
resource class in F1–F6

Evaluation: any satisfied forbid denies; else any satisfied permit allows; else deny. Any evaluation error is a deny (ADR-0030 §1). Not in the floor, by design: epoch fencing (the mechanism, ahead of the floor), the round bound (a count), the rules floor (bounds issuances), Invoke hermeticity (a property of the allowlist entry). The draft's own comment still calls ADR-0040 and ADR-0041 "Proposed"; both were ratified in Batch 20 (G7 §1.1).

Constants: 2 principals, 3 seats (one per kind), 4 actions. Each mutation breaks exactly its property: M_KIND (the grant path ignores the kind bound) and M_SEAT (one-live-lease keyed by seat, the reference's behaviour before R5).
Proved (ADR-0037 B25; ADR-0046 §4): Seats_proof.tla, 110 obligations, OnlyThinkersAuthor not under M_KIND and OneSeatPerPrincipal not under M_SEAT; RunSeats_proof.tla, 147 obligations,
OnlyThinkersActuate not under M_KIND, ObserversConsultAndReport not under M_KIND, M_DOMAIN, NoNameCrossesDomains not under M_DOMAIN. Of the modules, for every behaviour; the rows here stay with TLC.

The binding table now agrees with these rows (ADR-0046 §5, correction 1): M_OBSEMIT breaks none of the three invariants, since it narrows an observer's bound and they are upper bounds, and M_DOMAIN breaks
ObserversConsultAndReport as well as NoNameCrossesDomains. The table had listed M_OBSEMIT and missed M_DOMAIN.

M_OBSEMIT is ADR-0037 §4's struck provisional Run column (an observer seat with emission only): every property holds and no Observer ever consults. The results file's header still reads "ADR-0043 §8, Proposed"; ADR-0043
was ratified in Batch 20.
